* Run the sprint cadence for the technical teams (planning, reviews, retrospectives) and accept completed work against technical acceptance criteria.
* Hold a regular roadmap review (at least quarterly) with the Product Manager, engineering and architecture for your domains, and re-sequence as dependencies, risks and priorities change.
* Define the business outcome each technical initiative is meant to move (for example, faster new-program setup, higher reuse of shared capabilities, or better reliability), the KPIs that will measure it and the baseline, before it is prioritized, and report results after release.

Technical Requirements & Design Partnership

* Define functional and non-functional requirements for your domains, including performance, scalability, availability, security, privacy and auditability, with measurable targets.
* Review API contracts, data models and integration designs with engineering and architecture; evaluate connector and integration feasibility and identify technical risks early.
* Participate in design reviews and architecture discussions, represent product priorities in technical trade-off decisions, and record decisions and their rationale.
* Lead technical discovery and spikes with engineering leads and internal platform consumers to inform backlog priorities and reduce uncertainty before work is committed.
* Define data, interface and configuration requirements so that new capabilities are built once and reused across programs, solving the problem for many customers rather than one.

Shared Capabilities & Cross-Team Dependencies

* Own the shared-capability view for your domains: what exists, who consumes it, what is planned, and where a request from a Product Owner is better solved once, for everyone.
* Work with Product Owners to translate their needs into technical requirements, and bring shared needs and boundary questions to the Product Manager instead of solving them in isolation.
* Coordinate dependencies across engineering teams, integration and data platforms, vendors and other product areas; keep them visible and escalate conflicts that cannot be resolved at team level.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Security and Operations on privacy, security, audit and regulatory requirements that shape the technical roadmap.

Release, Quality & Reliability

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Network to Code is a network automation software company built by network engineers, for network engineers. Through our industry-leading Network Source of Truth and Automation platform, Nautobot, and expert services, we help some of the world’s largest and most complex enterprises build and operate smarter, more automated networks.

What sets us apart is our people—a collaborative team of innovators, engineers, and lifelong learners who enjoy solving complex challenges, sharing knowledge, and shaping what’s next. Our work is grounded in real customer needs, and the insights we gain in the field directly influence the technology we build.

Recognized as an Inc. Best Workplace, an Inc. 5000 company, and a leader in network automation and NetDevOps by Gartner, Network to Code is a place where talented people can do meaningful work and make a visible impact. Join us and help shape the future of network automation.

IMPACT OF THIS ROLE:

As a Customer Success Manager, you are the customer’s trusted partner after the sale, and a critical driver of NTC’s growth. You keep each customer engaged and coordinated through their consulting engagements and Nautobot software adoption, so they see real value from their investment. You lead the work to renew Nautobot subscriptions on time, and you connect customers and partners to the NTC resources that help them get the most from the platform.

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

* Own a portfolio of customers. Run onboarding, success plans, adoption milestones and quarterly business reviews.
* Coordinate across Delivery, Support, Product and Sales so the customer has one accountable point of contact during consulting engagements and software rollouts.
* Manage renewal readiness. Track every renewal from 120 days out, flag risk early using NTC’s customer health framework, and close on-time renewals together with the account owner.
* Drive adoption: apps, integrations, use cases and user growth. Connect customers and partners to NTC enablement such as training, certifications, the community and office hours.
* Identify expansion signals (new use cases, sites, apps, services) and hand qualified opportunities to the Client Executive or PS Sales Executive.
* Gather the voice of the customer for Product and Marketing, including references and case studies.
* Drive a high level and caliber of customer and partner facing activity and lead with curiosity and executive acumen.

WHAT YOU BRING:

* Drive Customer Outcomes: You measure success by the value customers get from Nautobot, not by activity, and you tie every success plan and QBR to their business goals.
* Own It: You own renewal readiness for your portfolio. When you see risk, you raise it early and come with a plan rather than waiting for the renewal date.
* Go the Extra Mile: You do what it takes to get a stalled rollout moving, whether that’s an extra working session, rallying the right NTC experts, or following through until adoption sticks.
* Stay Humble & Keep Learning: You keep growing your knowledge of network automation and the Nautobot platform. You learn from engineers, customers and the community, and bring those lessons back to the team.
* Be Empathetic: You understand the pressure network teams face when they’re asked to change how they work, and you meet customers where they are on their automation journey.
* Treat Others with Respect: You work with Delivery, Support, Product, Sales and partners as one team, so the customer gets one coordinated experience and colleagues get credit for their part.

WHAT YOU HAVE:

* 4–8 years in customer success, technical account management or engagement management for enterprise software and/or professional services.
* A record of hitting gross and net retention targets and on-time renewal rates.
* Working knowledge of network operations and automation. Nautobot, NetBox, Ansible, Python or source-of-truth experience is a plus.
* Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and keep executives and technical stakeholders aligned.
* Excellent written communication and QBR presentation skills.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED:

* On-time renewal rate and gross revenue retention (GRR)
* Net revenue retention (NRR) and expansion pipeline sourced
* Customer health score movement and adoption milestones achieved
* Customer and partner enablement participation (training, certifications)

LOCATION OF THIS ROLE:

* Remote, US
* Up to 25% travel

  

WHY US:

At Network to Code, you won’t just work with the brightest minds in network automation—you’ll grow alongside them. We’re a team of builders, innovators, and mentors who believe in pushing the boundaries of what’s possible while lifting each other up along the way.

Our culture is rooted in collaboration, inclusivity, and shared purpose. With a remote-first mindset and a globally distributed team, we stay closely connected through virtual events, team-building sessions, and day-to-day collaboration—so no matter where you are, you’ll feel part of something bigger.

We’re proud to foster an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual can thrive, whether you're a seasoned expert or a rising star.

We’ve been recognized as an Inc. Best Workplace and named to the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies—proof that we’re not only building cutting-edge solutions, but also a company where people love to work. Our impact has also been acknowledged in multiple Gartner reports, highlighting our leadership and innovation in the field.

When you join Network to Code, you’re not just joining a company, you’re joining a movement to redefine how networks are deployed, managed, and consumed. Come help us shape the future of networking, one automation at a time.

*Network to Code is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to celebrating diversity and promoting a culture of inclusivity. We believe in equal opportunities for all employees and qualified applicants irrespective of race

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - MLS & Associations
jobs.description:
As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Lone Wolf, you will own the ongoing success of a portfolio of MLS and Association customers and help them achieve meaningful business outcomes through our solutions. You will serve as a trusted advisor, customer advocate, and internal orchestrator across the post-sale journey. Your role is to understand what success means for each customer, translate those goals into a clear plan, drive adoption and value realization, identify risk early, and coordinate the right resources to keep the customer moving forward. This is not simply a relationship-management or issue-escalation role. Our CSMs are expected to take accountability for the customer experience, lead with insight, maintain strong operational discipline, and ensure customers and internal teams have a clear understanding of goals, progress, risks, and next steps.

Our MLS and Association customers serve thousands of real estate professionals, and their success is measured both by their own organizational health and by the value they deliver to their members. You will work with executive leaders, staff, and board members to align our solutions to their strategic priorities.

### **Responsibilities:**

* **Own Customer Outcomes:** Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business, priorities, workflows, stakeholders, and desired outcomes, including their governance structure, member needs, and strategic goals. Translate those objectives into clear success criteria, milestones, and an actionable customer Success Plan.
* **Drive Adoption and Value:** Use product knowledge, customer conversations, usage data, and business context to identify adoption gaps and opportunities across the organization and its membership. Guide customers toward the workflows and behaviors that will help them realize greater value from Lone Wolf solutions.
* **Lead Proactive Engagement:** Conduct regular, proactive virtual and in-person meetings (1:1 or group) based on customer needs, segment, risk, and opportunity. Lead purposeful conversations with staff, executives, and, as needed, boards and committees to share updates and insights, provide best practices, address obstacles, and ensure customers are deriving ongoing value from their investment.
* **Manage Customer Health and Risk:** Continuously assess customer health indicators and usage data to proactively identify potential risks early, diagnose root causes, and lead documented recovery plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, and communication.
* **Orchestrate the Customer Experience:** Coordinate effectively across Support, implementation, Product, Sales, and other teams to deliver a connected customer experience. While you may not personally perform every action, you will maintain ownership of customer communication, internal alignment, and follow-through.
* **Build Renewal Readiness:** Ensure customers are positioned for renewal by helping them achieve measurable value, maintaining strong alignment with executive and board-level stakeholders, and surfacing risks well before the renewal date, accounting for governance processes, budget cycles, and formal review timelines. Partner closely with Sales or the appropriate commercial owner to provide an accurate, evidence-based view of account health, outcomes, and renewal risk.
* **Contribute to Team Excellence:** Share knowledge, contribute ideas, strengthen playbooks and best practices, and help build a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

### **Requirements:**

* Customer-first mindset with a passion for driving customer outcomes and delivering value through every interaction
* 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing Success role (Customer Success, Account Management, or similar) in a SaaS environment
* Demonstrated ability to understand customer business needs and connect software adoption to measurable outcomes
* Strong consultative skills, including discovery, active listening, problem diagnosis, and the ability to guide or challenge customers constructively
* Experience managing a portfolio of customers with competing priorities, risks, and deadlines
* Executive presence and comfort engaging senior leaders and presenting to boards, committees, or other group audiences
* A vocal team player and emerging leader: you speak up, contribute ideas, and help lift the team through positivity, initiative, and knowledge-sharing
* Strong written and verbal communication skills: you know how to simplify complex topics and tailor your message to your audience
* Solid problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to managing customer needs and resolving issues
* Collaborative and resourceful: you know when to own it and when to loop in teammates or other departments
* A keen interest in technology and helping customers adopt software to improve their business
* **Preferred:** Experience with MLS, REALTOR® associations, or other membership-based or governance-driven organizations, or a strong working knowledge of the real estate industry
* Willingness to travel up to 20% for customer meetings and industry events

jobs.description:
United States (Remote) Category Customer Success, Services, & Support

  

Job description

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
  
  
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

### **Senior Consultant, Member Experience**

### **The Role**

Health plans and healthcare providers are navigating an increasingly complex landscape marked by evolving quality frameworks, shifting regulatory standards, and rising expectations from the populations they serve. As a Senior Consultant in Member Experience, you will serve as a trusted advisor bringing health plans and healthcare providers together.

In this role, you will be at the forefront of a major industry shift: bridging the traditional divide between payers and providers to improve the end-to-end patient and member journey. Working directly with health plan leaders, medical groups, and clinical operations teams, you will combine deep operational healthcare knowledge with proven continuous improvement methodologies to build strong cross-entity partnerships, elevate quality metrics, and drive measurable performance across Star Ratings and CAHPS. If you are passionate about being a change agent whose work directly impacts the care and lives of millions of people nationwide, this role is for you.

### **How You’ll Find Success**

* **Payer-Provider Bridge Builder:** Understands the operational realities of both health plans and medical provider groups; builds genuine collaboration and trust across executive leaders, physician groups, and clinical staff.
* **Continuous Improvement Driver:** Skilled in applying structured problem-solving and quality improvement frameworks (e.g., Plan-Do-Study-Act / PDSA cycles) to uncover root causes and build sustainable operational workflows.
* **Coach & Facilitator:** Comfortably engages and trains diverse audiences—from executive roundtables and town halls to clinic managers and frontline teams—through interactive virtual sessions and hands-on onsite workshops.
* **Data-to-Action Interpreter:** Adept at reading and interpreting complex performance metrics (CAHPS, HEDIS, HOS, Star Ratings) and translating them into clear, practical roadmaps without getting lost in technical reporting.
* **Adaptable & Client-Centric:** Thrives in a dynamic consulting environment, easily shifting between strategic advisory, remote delivery, and onsite client facilitation across diverse regions.

### **How You’ll Grow**

* **Expand Scope of Influence:** Broaden your reach beyond a single health system or payer to guide dozens of medical groups and major regional/national health plans across the country.
* **Lead Cutting-Edge Transformation:** Be an active driver in one of healthcare’s most critical evolutions—uniting health plans and provider networks into collaborative care partners.
* **Hone Executive Advisory & Facilitation:** Deepen your expertise in leading high-stakes client engagements, executive coaching, office hours, and collaborative exchange programs.
* **Deepen Quality & Regulatory Expertise:** Strengthen your mastery of modern healthcare quality programs, value-based care models, Medicare Advantage Star Ratings, Medicaid, and Commercial lines of business.

### **Things You’ll Do**

* **Bridge Health Plans & Provider Networks:** Collaborate with health plan liaison teams and medical practices to align on shared quality goals, improve communications, and strengthen provider-payer relationships.
* **Drive Direct Performance Improvement:** Partner with provider practices and clinical groups to lead operational improvement initiatives, utilizing methodologies such as Plan-Do-Study-Act (PDSA) to enhance patient and member interactions.
* **Facilitate Training & Coaching:** Deliver impactful virtual and onsite workshops, town halls, office hours, and coaching sessions through collaborative initiatives (such as our HX Exchange program).
* **Interpret Performance & Survey Metrics:** Analyze and interpret CAHPS, HEDIS, HOS, and Star Ratings data alongside operational metrics to identify performance gaps and track measurable progress.
* **Manage End-to-End Client Engagements:** Lead client project scopes, stakeholder alignment, and delivery timelines, ensuring initiatives translate into sustainable, measurable outcomes.

### **What We’re Looking For On Your Resume**

**Go to Market Enablement Manager**

DefenseStorm is looking for a Go-to-Market Enablement Manager to help our Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams turn strategy into consistent execution. You’ll build and run the programs, playbooks, and practical learning experiences that help our teams ramp faster, tell a clear and differentiated story, and guide customers from initial discovery through renewal and expansion.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for a systems thinker who can set the enablement roadmap, build the program, craft the workflows, lead the workshops, and facilitate the coaching. Working closely with GTM leadership, Product Marketing, Product, Revenue Operations, and technical subject matter experts, you’ll enable our teams to translate complex cybersecurity capabilities into customer-centered conversations that resonate with banking technology, security, and risk leaders.

You’ll also make AI a practical part of how our GTM teams work—improving preparation, content, coaching, and repeatable workflows without sacrificing accuracy, judgment, or human connection. Success means more than training completion: it means observable behavior change and measurable improvement in GTM effectiveness.  
  
**Location**

* Alpharetta, GA
* Remote

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Assess skills, content, and workflow gaps across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Partner with leadership within the first 90 days to prioritize programs tied to pipeline creation & sales execution, then customer retention & expansion.
* Design structured learning paths with clear milestones, practical exercises, and certifications. Combine live instruction, SME sessions, call reviews, role-play, and self-directed learning, so readiness is demonstrated—not just checked off.
* Partner with Product Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Collaborative SOC experts to help teams explain DefenseStorm’s platform, differentiation, and customer outcomes. Equip teams to connect cybersecurity, risk, and governance capabilities to the priorities of bank and credit union buyers.
* Translate positioning, segmentation, buyer insights, and launches into discovery guides, talk tracks, objection handling, competitive battlecards, and customer-facing narratives. Reinforce consistent, accurate messaging across the customer journey.
* Build practical programs around prospecting, discovery, qualification, business-case development, stakeholder engagement, and competitive selling. Use call recordings and deal insights to identify gaps, share effective approaches, and equip managers to reinforce skills in their regular coaching.
* Partner with Customer Success to develop value-review, renewal, and cross-sell playbooks that connect customer needs to relevant capabilities and measurable outcomes. Strengthen Sales-to-CS handoffs and continuity of the customer story.
* Develop reusable prompts, templates, and lightweight automations for account research, meeting preparation, content adaptation, and coaching. Partner with Revenue Operations on integrations and data workflows, with clear human-review steps and safeguards for sensitive information and output quality.
* Organize and maintain accessible enablement resources with clear ownership, review cycles, and version control. Work with content owners to keep materials current and retire outdated guidance.

40

Full time

new_jobs.title: Associate Project Manager, Payer & Employer Partnerships
new_jobs.description:
**Trial Library is an AI-native research platform with a mission to improve healthcare outcomes by expanding access to precision medicine.**

**About Trial Library**

Trial Library is an AI-native enrollment and care navigation platform that accelerates access to precision medicine. In collaboration with biopharmaceutical manufacturers, payers, and health systems, Trial Library enables the delivery of clinical trials as a standard care option - improving patient access, advancing oncology outcomes, and reducing the total cost of care. Backed by leading healthcare venture capital firms, Trial Library’s platform is currently deployed in 840+ clinics and 3,000+ providers nationwide.

### **About the Role**

Reporting to the Head of Payer Strategy, the Associate Project Manager will support Trial Library’s payer and employer partnerships and make sure partners have a smooth experience from launch onward. This is a hands-on, client-facing role that requires cross-functional collaboration. You will be the day-to-day point of contact for active health plan and employer partners and keep every partner informed, supported, and engaged.

### **Your Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the main day-to-day contact for active health plan and employer partners: keep regular communication going, share updates, and gather feedback.
* Lead implementation and launch of new partnerships, including eligibility file setup, referral pathways, member communication plans, and integration with existing care management or benefits programs.
* Own all partner inquiries and troubleshooting, resolving issues quickly.
* Work cross functionally with the operations, provider partnerships team, and products team leading efforts to ensure all client deliverables are executed on time and with superior quality in mind.
* Deliver timely, accurate reports to partners on Trial Library’s performance, including member outreach, engagement, navigation, trial matching, and enrollment outcomes.
* Help the Head of Payer Strategy develop value and ROI reporting that shows the clinical and economic impact of partnerships.
* Prepare and lead partner presentations, from program launch to quarterly business reviews and renewal conversations.
* Oversee all partner-facing materials, including member communications, benefit collateral, co-branded outreach, and performance documentation.
* Track account health and flag chances to expand or renew to the Head of Payer Strategy.
* Help build scalable processes for partner onboarding, reporting, and account management.
* Make sure partner communications and data handling follow HIPAA and contract requirements.
* Stay current on Trial Library’s product offering and value for health plans, employers, and their members.

### **Your Requirements:**

* 3–5 years of experience in health plan operations, employer benefits, care management, healthcare account management, or customer success.
* Experience with payer or employer reporting needs, such as engagement and utilization metrics, outcomes, and value or ROI reporting.
* Familiarity with health plan operations, employer-sponsored benefits, or population health programs.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA and handling protected health information (PHI).
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple partners at once.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a high level of professionalism with internal and external stakeholders.
* An analytical approach, comfortable using data to drive action and tell a clear story.
* A bias toward action, stepping in before issues arise.
* Able to work autonomously.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, early-stage startup.

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience in healthcare technology, digital health, or a high-growth startup.
* Familiarity with oncology, clinical trials, precision medicine, or patient navigation.
* Experience supporting value-based care programs or payer partnerships.
* Experience with CRM and reporting tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Tableau, Looker).

### **Compensation & On-Site Requirement**

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA, with a requirement of three days per week in the office; Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. The salary range for this position is $108,000–$135,000 per year and reflects a good faith estimate of base pay for candidates working in this location. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

### **Why Trial Library**

* Meaningful impact — helping patients access clinical trials faster through better technology and workflows
* High ownership environment — autonomy to build, test, and influence strategy across the business
* Collaborative team culture — low ego, high trust, and close partnership across functions
* Opportunity for growth — join at an early stage with meaningful exposure to company-building and decision-making

### **Our Core Values**

* Ally is our favorite moniker
* The broadest reach is worth the effort
* Celebrate measurable improvements in access and outcomes
* Fearless advocates for representation in research
* Incentives matter to stakeholders choosing our products

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage, backed by Y Combinator, with offices in San Francisco and Atlanta. We do the insurance work end to end for about 1,000 new small businesses a month, with agents and people working the same accounts.

### **Role in one line**

Own a book of small businesses after they buy, keep them covered as they grow, and run the whole book with agents.

A small business buys a policy and keeps moving. It hires its first employee, adds a truck, wins a contract that requires workers’ comp, opens a second location. Those are triggers, and they are predictable. At most brokerages nobody notices until the renewal, or the claim. At Harper you notice first.

### **Why now**

Our most important accounts need one named owner, and today too many people touch them. Hundreds of our customers also need coverage they do not have yet, most often workers’ comp and commercial auto, and that is the cheapest growth we have. You start with about 250 accounts. Agents read every email, call, payment and document on each one, flag what changed, and draft the outreach. You decide what matters and make the call.

### **What you own**

* **One named owner per account, and it is you.** The customer knows who to call, and you close the loop.
* **Coverage that matches the business.** New vehicles, payroll, locations and contracts. Catch the gap before it becomes a problem.
* **Growth where it is real.** Workers’ comp, commercial auto and property for businesses that need them. Never coverage they do not need.
* **Accounts protected early.** Payment problems, pending cancellations and audits: you see them first and get them fixed with the right teammate.
* **Renewals started early,** with our renewals team, well before the deadline.
* **Your own automations.** The parts of the book that eat your week, you automate.

### **What done means**

* No surprise cancellations in your book.
* When a customer is thinking about leaving, you see it in the account before the notice arrives; when one leaves, the reason is on the record.
* Your book is bigger than when you started, and you did not add hours to run it.

### **Your first 90 days**

* **Day 30:** you know your book, you are licensed or close, and every account has a current status and a next action.
* **Day 60:** you have automated what was eating your week, and your first expansions have closed.
* **Day 90:** no surprise cancellations, and the book has grown.

### **Who thrives here**

* You have owned a book of customers at a fintech, software or services company, with a number: retention, expansion or activation.
* You use agents and automation in your own work and can show how you handled a bigger book without more hours.
* You are direct on the phone and comfortable talking about money.
* Bonus: you have served contractors, truckers, restaurants or other small business owners.

### **What we teach, what you bring**

We teach the insurance and pay for your license. You bring book ownership, curiosity about what changed in a customer’s business, and the habit of building tools for yourself.

### **Who should not apply**

* You want the highest quota and the most variable pay. Our renewals and new business teams carry more.
* You treat a request for a certificate as a ticket rather than a conversation.
* You want to run quarterly business reviews for ten strategic accounts. This is a book of hundreds.

### **Pay, schedule and place**

**Front Desk / Guest Services & Spa Operations Associate**

Piedmont Springs | Oakland, CA

**First, an important note: this is not a sedentary receptionist position.**

Although every member of our Guest Services team works at the front desk, this is an **active, hands-on position**. Our staff rotate between front-desk responsibilities and helping operate the spa throughout the shift.

On any given shift, you may be checking in guests and answering phones one moment, then walking through the facility to reset spa rooms, handle towels and laundry, check restrooms and common areas, restock supplies, or assist with other operational needs the next.

**If you're looking for a job where you'll spend most of your shift sitting behind a desk, this probably isn't the right position for you.**

On the other hand, if you enjoy staying busy, moving around, helping customers, working independently, and having different things to do throughout your shift, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

**What You'll Do**

new_jobs.title: Payments Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**At a glance:** Atlanta (first seat) or San Francisco, on site · $65K to $90K in Atlanta, $85K to $115K in San Francisco, plus bonus and equity · No insurance experience needed · Payments, disputes, lending or reconciliation experience is the skill

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage, backed by Y Combinator, with offices in San Francisco and Atlanta. We do the insurance work end to end for about 1,000 new small businesses a month, with agents and people working the same accounts.

### **Role in one line**

Resolve the money problems that would otherwise cost a small business its coverage, from one bounced payment to a batch that went wrong for hundreds.

A payment does not reconcile. A customer disputes a charge. A cancellation notice conflicts with the account record. A financed policy has no finance agreement attached. You establish what is actually true, talk to the customer, and carry the issue to a documented resolution.

### **Why now**

Payment problems are the biggest reason small businesses lose coverage with us, and it is rarely because they will not pay. Most do not know they have to, because signing and paying are separate steps. We stood up a payments unit this fall with a simple rule: the queue is at zero every day. This seat makes it a function, alongside an AI operator who automates what you do by hand.

### **What you own**

* **Payment questions, traced to the end.** Current state, amount, owner and next action, proven from the records, not from one status field.
* **Finance agreements.** Match each financed policy to its agreement and fix the ones that do not match. A policy marked paid in full that was actually financed is the error that multiplies.
* **Pending cancellations.** Work the list from the carrier and finance company portals before the cancellation date, not after. The portal’s list is the truth, not our sheet.
* **Disputes and refunds.** Gather the records, coordinate the review, tell the customer, and record the outcome. Refunds go through one channel, every time.
* **Reconciliation.** Compare the customer, payment and policy records with outside confirmation before you close anything.
* **The fix behind the fix.** Automate the reconciliation you did by hand last month, and flag the patterns that need a product or finance change.

### **What done means**

* Every conclusion names its evidence and the account or transaction it belongs to.
* Cancellation answers reflect the latest event in the chain, not the loudest notice.
* Repeat contacts go down because the issue was fixed and explained.

### **Your first 90 days**

* **Day 30:** you work the pending-cancellation list on your own and close cases with the evidence attached.
* **Day 60:** you own one recurring money problem end to end, with a weekly number.
* **Day 90:** you have automated or eliminated at least one manual reconciliation step.

### **Who thrives here**

* You have worked in payment operations, disputes, collections, lending, fraud or accounts receivable, ideally somewhere with real volume.
* You can write a crisp message to an engineer and a calm one to a frustrated business owner in the same hour.
* You notice when a number is off by one payment, and you find out why.
* You know when to keep digging and when to escalate.
* You use spreadsheets, queries or AI tools to work faster, and you can show us what you built.

### **What we teach, what you bring**

We teach premium finance, our carriers’ billing, and how a policy cancels and reinstates. You bring payments judgment, numeracy and calm on the phone with someone worried about losing their coverage.

### **Who should not apply**

* You want a back-office job with no customer conversations.
* You close cases when you transfer them.
* You decide payment or cancellation status from one field.

### **Pay, schedule and place**

* Atlanta: $65K to $90K. San Francisco: $85K to $115K. Plus bonus and equity. The difference is location; the job is the same.
* In the office Monday to Friday, starting around 8 AM local. Weekly carrier sweeps, cancellation dates and finance-company cutoffs set the rhythm, and some weeks the list is long.
* Next steps: senior payments roles, team lead, or the team that automates payments.

### **Benefits**

Health, dental and vision, plus each office’s meals and commuter or parking support.

### **How we hire (usually inside two weeks)**

* A call with our customer operations team. We reply within 48 hours at every stage.
* A work sample: three practice records that disagree about one customer’s payment. Find the truth and draft the message to the customer.
* A Super Day on site, working practice cases beside the team. We decide within 48 hours.

### **How to apply**

Send your resume and a short example of a money problem that crossed several systems or teams: how you found the real state, what you told the customer, and how you proved it was resolved.

*Harper is an equal opportunity employer. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we will make it work. For San Francisco roles, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in a manner consistent with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.*

Compensation Range: $65K - $115K

This role owns project scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, safety coordination, commercial performance, stakeholder alignment, and customer satisfaction. * Validate logic, dependencies, critical path, resource needs, customer prerequisites, supplier commitments, and recovery options.

**Risk, Quality, Safety, and Compliance**

* Create and maintain the project risk and opportunity register with owners, mitigation actions, due dates, financial exposure, and escalation thresholds.

A **340B Implementation Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst** ensures that a covered entity's 340B Drug Discount Program is implemented, operated, and maintained in full compliance with HRSA regulations, internal policies, and program integrity standards. This role blends compliance oversight, process implementation, and quality assurance to ensure the 340B program delivers intended savings and meets all regulatory and internal standards. * Conduct regular internal audits of 340B Office of Pharmacy Affairs Information System (OPAIS) records, retail pharmacies (entity-owned and contract), and Medicaid claims to ensure adherence to HRSA requirements
* Validate patient, provider, and drug eligibility for all 340B transactions
* Review and interpret state Medicaid billing requirements and compare against claims data
* Participate in external 340B program audits and prepare data/documentation for review

**Implementation & Process Oversight:**

* Develop and maintain 340B policies, procedures, and workflows for purchasing, referral capture, and contract pharmacy management
* Administer referral prescription capture processes and ensure documentation supports eligibility
* Monitor contract pharmacy portals for missed claims, investigate denials/reversals, and coordinate remediation
* Configure and maintain eligible provider tables, location/site mapping, and excluded NDCs/drugs in compliance with internal and HRSA standards

**Quality Assurance & Risk Management:**

* Identify compliance risks, prevent diversion, and ensure consistent processes across all points of service
* Develop training programs (e.g., 340B University OnDemand) for staff on 340B procedures and inventory management
* Monitor regulatory updates and communicate implications to program operations

**Reporting & Collaboration:**

* Generate program utilization, savings, and exception reports for management and stakeholders
* Collaborate with IT, audit, accounting, and pharmacy teams to share data, improve efficiency, and ensure compliance
* Provide data, reports, and insights to support other business units

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma/GED; pharmacy or healthcare-related degree preferred
* 1–3+ years in 340B program work; prior QA, compliance, or pharmacy operations experience preferred

* In-depth knowledge of HRSA 340B regulations and program mechanics
* Proficiency in Excel, SQL, data analysis, and 340B software
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Implementation quality scores.
* Number of post-go-live defects identified.
* Defect resolution turnaround times.
* First-pass testing success rates.
* Accuracy of implementation validations.
* Compliance audit findings.
* Client implementation satisfaction scores.
* On-time project delivery support.
* Reduction in implementation rework.
* Effectiveness of risk identification and mitigation.

* Health insurance
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Dental and Vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan

As a leading 340B Third-Party Administrator, we help covered entities maximize program compliance, improve patient access to care, and strengthen healthcare outcomes.

new_jobs.title: 340B Implementation Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Job Title:** 340B Implementation Specialist

**Location:** Remote  
**Vertical / Department:** Customer Engagement / Implementation & Onboarding

**Reports To:** Implementation Manager  
**Job Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

**Position Summary:**

A **340B Implementation Specialist** leads the end‑to‑end onboarding and deployment of 340B systems, ensuring regulatory adherence, operational efficiency, and smooth client handoff to client success. This role ensures alignment on data requirements, workplan execution, stakeholder coordination, and system configuration, serving as the primary point of contact until the client transitions to a Client Success Manager. The **340B Implementation Specialist** is responsible for guiding health systems or covered entities through the full lifecycle of implementing a 340B software from kickoff to go‑live. A **340B Implementation Specialist** is the bridge between regulatory compliance and technology deployment, ensuring that 340B programs are launched successfully, remain compliant, and are optimized for long‑term value.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Implementation Leadership:**

* Lead full‑lifecycle implementation of 340B compliance software for new clients.
* Develop and manage detailed workplans, timelines, and deliverables.
* Conduct weekly client touchpoints to track progress and resolve issues.
* Coordinate internal resources and cross‑functional stakeholders.

**Data & Technical Coordination:**

* Define and communicate data specifications for system setup.
* Review, validate, and troubleshoot client data files.
* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure correct configuration.
* Ensure compliance workflows and documentation are properly structured.

**Client Engagement & Communication:**

* Serve as the main contact during implementation.
* Provide training, walkthroughs, and user guidance.
* Manage expectations and communicate milestones clearly.
* Escalate and mitigate risks proactively.

**Go‑Live & Handoff:**

* Plan and execute go‑live activities.
* Confirm system readiness and client confidence before launch.
* Deliver comprehensive handoff documentation to the Client Success team.

**Qualifications:**

* 3+ years in 340B program operations, compliance, or healthcare systems.
* Strong project management, client‑facing communication, and technical coordination abilities.
* Understanding of HRSA 340B regulations, covered entity requirements, and pharmacy operations.
* Proficiency with MS Office and compliance/audit software.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* On-time completion of implementation tasks and milestones.
* Successful onboarding of assigned clients.
* Data accuracy and configuration quality scores.
* Client satisfaction ratings during implementation.
* Go-live success rates.
* Number of implementation projects supported concurrently.
* Training completion and adoption metrics.
* Compliance with implementation documentation standards.

**What We Offer:**

* Health insurance
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Dental and Vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid time off

**Why Join Pillr Health?**

As a leading 340B Third-Party Administrator, we help covered entities maximize program compliance, improve patient access to care, and strengthen healthcare outcomes.

**Go to Market Enablement Manager**

DefenseStorm is looking for a Go-to-Market Enablement Manager to help our Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams turn strategy into consistent execution. You’ll build and run the programs, playbooks, and practical learning experiences that help our teams ramp faster, tell a clear and differentiated story, and guide customers from initial discovery through renewal and expansion.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for a systems thinker who can set the enablement roadmap, build the program, craft the workflows, lead the workshops, and facilitate the coaching. Working closely with GTM leadership, Product Marketing, Product, Revenue Operations, and technical subject matter experts, you’ll enable our teams to translate complex cybersecurity capabilities into customer-centered conversations that resonate with banking technology, security, and risk leaders.

You’ll also make AI a practical part of how our GTM teams work—improving preparation, content, coaching, and repeatable workflows without sacrificing accuracy, judgment, or human connection. Success means more than training completion: it means observable behavior change and measurable improvement in GTM effectiveness.  
  
**Location**

* Alpharetta, GA
* Remote

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Assess skills, content, and workflow gaps across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Partner with leadership within the first 90 days to prioritize programs tied to pipeline creation & sales execution, then customer retention & expansion.
* Design structured learning paths with clear milestones, practical exercises, and certifications. Combine live instruction, SME sessions, call reviews, role-play, and self-directed learning, so readiness is demonstrated—not just checked off.
* Partner with Product Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Collaborative SOC experts to help teams explain DefenseStorm’s platform, differentiation, and customer outcomes. Equip teams to connect cybersecurity, risk, and governance capabilities to the priorities of bank and credit union buyers.
* Translate positioning, segmentation, buyer insights, and launches into discovery guides, talk tracks, objection handling, competitive battlecards, and customer-facing narratives. Reinforce consistent, accurate messaging across the customer journey.
* Build practical programs around prospecting, discovery, qualification, business-case development, stakeholder engagement, and competitive selling. Use call recordings and deal insights to identify gaps, share effective approaches, and equip managers to reinforce skills in their regular coaching.

* Develop reusable prompts, templates, and lightweight automations for account research, meeting preparation, content adaptation, and coaching. Partner with Revenue Operations on integrations and data workflows, with clear human-review steps and safeguards for sensitive information and output quality.
* Organize and maintain accessible enablement resources with clear ownership, review cycles, and version control. Work with content owners to keep materials current and retire outdated guidance.
* Facilitate engaging workshops, launch-readiness sessions, and sales kickoff programming. Build communications and follow-through that help new skills, tools, and processes become daily habits.
* Partner with GTM leaders to design the operating mechanisms that reinforce new behaviors after kickoffs, launches, and training programs. * A track record of building or scaling onboarding, product enablement, and ongoing skills programs with measurable impact on performance.
* Experience with technical B2B products, ideally cybersecurity, and the ability to translate complex concepts into clear business value for different audiences.
* Strong facilitation and coaching skills: you’re equally comfortable leading a workshop, giving constructive feedback, and partnering with senior leaders.
* Experience partnering with sales and customer success leaders to build manager coaching cadences and reinforcement plans that sustain behavior change after a kickoff or launch.
* Practical understanding of consultative selling, qualification, and the customer lifecycle, from prospecting and discovery to renewal and expansion.
* Hands-on experience using CRM, conversation intelligence, and knowledge or learning platforms to diagnose needs, deliver programs, and assess results.
